name: Great Smoky Mountains National Park
policyReason: Pets may walk only the Gatlinburg and Oconaluftee River trails, plus campgrounds, picnic areas and roads.
summary: Pets may walk only the Gatlinburg and Oconaluftee River trails, plus campgrounds, picnic areas and roads.

excerpts.quote: Additionally, pets are permitted on two walking paths: the Gatlinburg Trail and the Oconaluftee River Trail.

dogRules.text: Allowed in campgrounds, picnic areas, parking areas and along roads.
